text: Citizens! By resolution of the district executive committee, the church of the village of Chetverodnevo is closed.
The bells are surrendered to the needs of industrialization. Go back to your homes.
Religion is opium for the people.
Church valuables are subject to requisition. Resistance will be treated as a counter-revolutionary act.
Comrade peasants! Get up off your knees. Do not obstruct the brigade's work.
Priest Lebedev! Hand over the keys voluntarily.
The struggle against religion is the struggle for socialism!
Away from the bell tower! Away! There will be a blast!
